scope: Equivalent family-specific solver-stage diagnostic; WDSat curve/interface inapplicable. No full-DLP or broad repetition-gate claim.
inputs: All 24 reuse targets plus eight fresh holdouts at n18/n30, prefix d8/d9, uniform and supported. Identical m=3 exclusions.
batch_policy: Always run the same frozen eight-target n30 d8 batch, regardless of cold outcomes. Setup shared only within the named batch and fully charged.
hypothesis: Nested fixed column spans remove repeated elimination without altering the block relaxation, traversal or complete outputs.
validation: All finite GF64 targets on three d4 spaces against independent signed-triple truth; every block certificate independently replayed from the unexpanded identity; identical rejection blocks and complete sets against unchanged reuse.
accounting: Field API add/mul/square, selected binary operations including cached basis copies, all setup and failed targets, extraction and signed-sum verification. Component units kept separate; no calibrated total-cost ratio. Logical cache slots are not peak RSS.
boundary: Matched strongest direct S3 reference; unchanged signed-triple yield bound. The unchanged coefficient preparation is an architecture-specific floor for this implementation, not a universal bound.
falsification: Any false rejection or missing/invalid complete relation invalidates correctness. Screen requires 20% fewer complete batch field API calls than reuse; report binary and setup costs even if this passes. Original promotion remains 20% lower calibrated total cost per relation across three increasing sizes.
